_doc: Malformed-LLM / robustness set (S-5). Each sibling file is a raw provider response carrying a *coercible* defect — the exact shapes v1's hand-written _normalize_tables / _normalize_lineage_rows had to absorb. The Pydantic validators in the structured-call loop (SDD §6.3, P0-5) must normalize each to the target below; because the defect is coercible, recovery happens WITHOUT consuming a retry.

tables_as_dict.json.defect: input_tables is a {name: [columns]} mapping instead of a list of table objects

tables_as_string.json.defect: input_tables is a single bare table-name string

tables_as_csv.json.defect: input_tables is a comma-separated string of table names

lineage_as_scalar.json.defect: lineage_rows is a single scalar string instead of a list of rows
